description:
kith-store/src/lib.rs:db_err() (line 1205) maps SQLite constraint violations to KithError::Validation (which surfaces as invalidArguments to JMAP clients) and all other errors to KithError::Store (which surfaces as serverFail). This classification is important: the wrong mapping turns a client mistake into a server error or vice versa.

The classification rationale is documented only in the db_err() function itself. At call sites — which are hundreds of .map_err(db_err) expressions throughout the store modules — there is no indication that constraint violations are handled differently from I/O errors.

Suggestion: add a one-line module-level comment in kith-store/src/lib.rs (near the imports) noting that db_err() maps constraint violations to Validation. This gives readers auditing JMAP error responses a place to look rather than requiring them to find db_err() first. The existing doc comment on db_err() itself is thorough; a forward pointer from the module level would complete the picture.
title: READABILITY: db_err error classification not obvious at call sites
